name: cable lying single arm cross lateral raise
description: A single-arm lateral raise done lying on your side or back on the floor with a low cable crossing the body. It trains the side delt under steady tension.
instructions: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
